title: Replicas beat tensor parallelism when the model fits: 2x TP=2 (1437 tok/s) vs 1x TP=4 (610 tok/s)

hardware.interconnect: PCIe Gen4 x16 (no NVLink; consumer driver restricts P2P)

variance.note: single measurement, reported by the source without variance

methodology: 8192-token context, 128 concurrent requests; single run as published
transferable: When the model fits on fewer GPUs, independent replicas outperform a wider tensor-parallel group on consumer PCIe hardware.
not_transferable: The concrete numbers (consumer cards, single run, specific model). The margin between 1437 and 610 should not be read as a universal 2.4x.
